_comment: Work order 420 (decision 104): where the parts of the galaxy map's frame picture (base pack, assets/shared/hud/galaxy_frame.png, Data's 'Strategiekarte_1440p_ohne_Gebaeude', RGBA 2560x1440) are, in the PICTURE's own pixels. Measured off the picture by the developer store's galaxy-frame tool, which the smoke test runs against the pack's picture; screens/galaxy_map/boxes.json is written from this file by the store's boxes tool and held to it within 1 px. Reference space (1920x1080) is picture px * 0.75.
_map_window_note: The star map's box: its native viewport (the box fitted to the game's 506:400, centred). The stars the game can place (mapgen_layout.cpp:131-151: scaled x 24..488, y 22..382 less 8, 6 or 4; a save of 54 stars measured at x 28..479, y 22..375) stand in picture px at x 438..1718 and y 173..1143..1154 here, which centres them in the picture's hole (y 46 to 1274 or lower over x 438..1718; Data, 19 November 2026: the picture sat 21 px high, 108 px of air above the topmost star against 150 below the lowest, the box 19 px too far up). The names that hang under the lowest stars (about 50 px, estimated) end at y 1205, 34 px above the contour at its tightest (1239 at x 375..437, outside the stars). The height 1100 is OURS, chosen against the frame's art and against 006d's word contrast (the fixture's Draconis label touches a background star's glow: 3.3:1 at 1084, 4.6:1 at 1100), decision 53.
_top_right_note: The status block's right edge, its middle line, and the box it must stay inside: right of min_left and above max_bottom. The top bar is a dark fill the block stands ON, but its line falls from y 45 to y 80 at about x 1990 (alpha column at x 1980-2020) and the lower line runs at y 74-80 right of it; the block must reach neither (measured off the picture). The smoke test 011a holds the block inside the box at every window size.
_label_note: The words of the icon bar: each starts label_gap px right of its icon's right edge (nav_icon_right, measured off the picture) and may reach label_pad_right px short of its segment's right edge; the play button's word stands right of its triangle (turn_label, x from, x to). The picture carries no text; the words are drawn in code, as the nav buttons' were (Data saw the bar without them on 18 November 2026).
_territory_window_note: Where a territory's fill and borders may be drawn (picture px): the whole picture height, left of the info panel - the frame is the limit (Data, 18 November 2026: Nazin was cut flat at y 1230 where the picture's hole reaches y 1286 at x 1580; the top bar and bottom contour are not straight, so no fixed y fits them). The picture's art is opaque (alpha ~250 outside its hole, measured) and is drawn after the map, so it covers whatever lies under it. Right 2066 stays clear of the info panel (x 2074); left 0, the picture is open there. OURS (decision 53); 090zzzzzzzzn holds it around the star box.
